draft.emotion: reflective and quiet, pausing to bring something back into focus
notes: Stem-changing verb (o → ue): recuerdo, recuerdas, recuerda, recuerdan.
'Recordar' takes a direct object without a preposition, whereas its synonym 'acordarse de' requires 'de': 'Recuerdo ese día' = 'Me acuerdo de ese día'.
Use 'recordar a' to say someone or something reminds you of another: 'Me recuerdas a tu hermano' (You remind me of your brother).
